semiconductor_relevance: Low — Machine House (India) Pvt. Ltd. specializes in anti-vibration solutions, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing or processing.
summary: Machine House (India) Pvt. Ltd. provides high-quality anti-vibration solutions, primarily for precision machining and measurements. They have a strong partnership with Bilz, focusing on manufacturing and marketing anti-vibration mounts and pads in India.
capabilities: Vibration isolation solutions for precision machining

regional_presence.India: Machine House is based in Nashik, India, and has a dealer network across major industrial cities.
